bearer_lifetime_rule: For most requests, App Store Connect rejects a token with a lifetime greater than 20 minutes (exp minus iat). A longer lifetime is accepted only for a token whose scope holds GET requests alone, on resources the page lists (builds, workflows, repositories and the like).
requests_rule: The provisioning command reads bundle ids, certificates and profiles and creates profiles; none of these resources is on the long-lived list and POST is never allowed one, so the 20-minute limit is the one that applies to every request it makes.
